title: Work column PR badges gray: rows must run the PR status lookup
answers: Work column PR badge is always gray
PR badges don't show open/merged/closed colors in the new desktop layout
body:
Symptom: In the work column of the new desktop layout, every session's PR badge is gray regardless of open, merged or closed.
Root cause: WorkColumn.tsx passed `withPrStatus={false}` to `ChannelItemRow`, so `useChannelTaskStatus` only knew a PR existed, not its state.
Fix pattern: Remove the opt-out so rows run the same cached per-task PR lookup as the Code sidebar; bound the cost host-side (see task-pr-status.ts `TaskPrStatusService`) rather than disabling it in the UI. The `withPrStatus` prop was deleted from `ChannelItemRow`.
Constraints: The space tree deliberately keeps the lookup off by calling `useChannelTaskStatus` directly instead of `ChannelItemRow` (documented in canvas/AGENTS.md). Colors: green open, purple merged, red closed, gray draft.
applies: desktop canvas ChannelItemRow / WorkColumn PR badge

PR status not updating in the work column display
search: Work column PR badges display gray because rows do not run the PR status lookup due to a `withPrStatus={false}` opt-out passed to ChannelItemRow. The fix is to remove the opt-out so rows run the same cached per-task PR lookup as the Code sidebar, with cost bounded host-side via TaskPrStatusService in `products/desktop/packages/workspace-server/src/services/git/task-pr-status.ts`. The `withPrStatus` prop was deleted from ChannelItemRow; space tree deliberately keeps the lookup off by calling useChannelTaskStatus directly instead (documented in canvas/AGENTS.md). Badge colors: green=open, purple=merged, red=closed, gray=draft. Applies to desktop canvas ChannelItemRow and WorkColumn PR badge display.
